claim.claim-text: 1. A method of wireless positioning performed by a user equipment, UE, comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes: an inverse of a minimum bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources; or, a minimum bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources across all positioning frequency layers on which the one or more PRS resources are transmitted.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes an inverse of an oversampling factor.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein the oversampling factor:
is configured to the UE by the network entity, is recommended by the UE, is based on a frequency range of the one or more PRS resources, or is a capability of the UE.

5. The method of claim 1, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes a minimum bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources across a reference PRS resource of the one or more PRS resources and at least one neighbor PRS resource of the one or more PRS resources.

6. The method of claim 5, wherein the reference PRS resource is transmitted by a reference transmission-reception point, TRP, and the at least one neighbor PRS resource is transmitted by at least one neighbor TRP.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes a logarithmic function of an inverse of a bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources.

8. The method of claim 1, wherein the one or more positioning measurements comprise: one or more reference signal time difference, RSTD, measurements; or one or more reception-to-transmission, Rx-Tx, time difference measurements.
9. A user equipment, LTE, comprising:

10. The UE of claim 9, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes: an inverse of a minimum bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources; or a minimum bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources across all positioning frequency layers on which the one or more PRS resources are transmitted.
11. The LTE of claim 9, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes an inverse of an oversampling factor, , wherein the oversampling factor is optionally:
configured to the UE by the network entity, recommended by the UE, based on a frequency range of the one or more PRS resources, or a capability of the UE.

12. The UE of claim 9, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes a minimum bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources across a reference PRS resource of the one or more PRS resources and at least one neighbor PRS resource of the one or more PRS resources, wherein the reference PRS resource is preferably transmitted by a reference transmission-reception point, TRP, and the at least one neighbor PRS resource is transmitted by at least one neighbor TRP.
13. The UE of claim 9, wherein the PRS bandwidth parameter includes a logarithmic function of an inverse of a bandwidth of the one or more PRS resources.
14. The UE of claim 9, wherein the one or more positioning measurements comprise one or more reference signal time difference, RSTD, measurements.
15. The UE of claim 9, wherein the one or more positioning measurements comprise one or more reception-to-transmission, Rx-Tx, time difference measurements.
